facts.fact: Ahram Online reports the Planning Ministry saying Egyptian startups attracted $614 million in 2025 from direct investment and debt financing, including $304 million through 69 venture capital deals per Magnitt.

Ahram Online reports the Ministerial Entrepreneurship Group reviewed a finalized Startup Charter of more than 80 government measures, with a startup definition and a certification system for incentives still being worked out and a first incentives package due.

EGY.note: Document names no hub, incubator or park.
